intro: Technology and government sectors bore the brunt of 34 remote code execution incidents tracked between April 12 and June 9, 2026, with 21 rated critical and 12 high. The threat actor PhantomCore was observed in these attacks. Five critical-severity vulnerabilities were frequently exploited: CVE-2026-20223 (CVSS 10), CVE-2025-54987, CVE-2026-22679, CVE-2026-31251, and CVE-2026-45033, all with a CVSS score of 9.8. Affected regions included Global, Asia, China, and Russia, with impact across manufacturing, research, and software development sectors.
